verdict: IPRoyal: Choose IPRoyal when a published $1.75/GB residential floor is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Thinner workflow depth than API/Actor platforms
bestFor: Teams that need a low published residential GB floor
Buyers comparing $1.75/GB to ThorData $2/GB and Decodo $3.75/GB starters
Projects that will validate quality/compliance before production volume
notIdealFor: Enterprises that require Bright Data / Oxylabs compliance-first proxy estates
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose IPRoyal when a published $1.75/GB residential floor is the job — not Bright Data enterprise commits by default. Compare Bright Data or Oxylabs for enterprise proxy estates; Decodo (Smartproxy) or ThorData for other budget GB tiles; Zyte or ScraperAPI for managed APIs.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
